title: Spicy Morning Braise
description: A hearty morning dish inspired by the flavors of Mexico, featuring tender beef, rich sauce, and a kick of heat from the jalapeño.
instructions: Season the beef cubes with salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot. Cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced jalapeño and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise the beef at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the beef with the rich sauce spooned over the top.
